messages:
amy: Quick heads-up — mobile sample app exposing raw user emails in logs when LOG_LEVEL=debug. Repro steps below.

leo: ugh, can you paste a snippet?

amy: here's the tail of the log from a local run:

```
2026-03-22 14:12:03.456 INFO  [MainActivity] User signed in: user=alice@example.com x-request-id=req_abc123
2026-03-22 14:12:03.457 DEBUG [Auth] Token fetch retry, headers: {"x-request-id":"req_abc123","authorization":"Bearer ..."}
```

tanya: that looks like PII + request-id in same line. Is REDACT_FIELDS set in the sampleapp env?

amy: yes, sampleapp sets REDACT_FIELDS=email,ssn in run config. Node and go sampleapps respect it, but kotlin mobile ignores it.

leo: likely an init ordering problem — logger instantiates at app startup before the redact middleware/hook is registered.

amy: right. in the kotlin sdk the redaction hook is added during SDK.init which we call later in onCreate.

ops-jen: can we reproduce reliably? steps?

amy: repro: 1) checkout branch mobile-sample. 2) set LOG_LEVEL=debug and REDACT_FIELDS=email. 3) run emulator and sign in. observe debug logs include emails.

tanya: quick workaround: set LOG_LEVEL=info until patch. Also block — remove emails from debug logs in the sample app code.

devex-bot: Created issue #6122 (kotlin sdk: redaction not applied if SDK.init occurs after logger creation).

amy: proposing change: register redaction hook inside static logger initializer in the SDK, or allow SDK to accept a pre-init hooks list. here's a gist of the idea:

```
// pseudocode
object LoggerFactory {
  init {
    registerRedactionHook(defaultRedactors())
  }
  fun create() = Logger(...)
}
```

leo: sounds good. also add an e2e test in sampleapp CI to run emulator w/ debug and check no emails in logs.

tanya: i'll draft a PR. marking as high-priority — leaks are GDPR-risky. :exclamation:

amy: thx! tagging @legal for visibility.

ops-jen: adding a short mitigation to the onboarding doc: "mobile sampleapp defaults to LOG_LEVEL=info in quickstart".

amy: Created a small branch with the sampleapp change and a repro test. PR coming in ~2h.

leo: :thumbsup:
